reviews.text:
My beloved dog received excellent care here.

Previously, we had to take our dog to a hospital far away, but when the trips became difficult, our dog started showing interest in this hospital through the glass during our walks. We decided to try taking him in, and since then, it has become his favorite place, a place he wants to visit every time we go for a walk. He was very fond of the nurses and the head veterinarian, even scratching at the door on days the hospital was closed. Looking back, I think our dog himself might have chosen this hospital.

Later, cancer was discovered during a regular health checkup, and we were referred to a university hospital where he underwent surgery, but unfortunately, he couldn't overcome the disease.

From the treatment of his illness to his final moments, the doctor provided incredibly compassionate care. I am deeply grateful for the thorough explanations he gave us as his condition changed, and for his willingness to address our anxieties and questions.

Also, although I'm sure this was very difficult news for the doctor as well, his honesty about the remaining time allowed our family to prepare ourselves. Thanks to that, we were able to cherish the limited time we had and create ample time for a proper farewell as a family.


And in his final moments, they gave us more than enough time to spend with him as a family. We weren't rushed, and we were able to spend that precious time together, coming to terms with our feelings.

The day after our dog's farewell ceremony, they even sent flowers from the hospital. Their thoughtfulness and concern until the very end was truly heartwarming and filled my heart with gratitude.

Thanks to the support of the doctor and staff, we were able to watch over him with peace of mind. Thank you so much for taking such good care of him.

I was at my wit's end when my beloved dog had an epileptic seizure, and this clinic saved me.

Even though it was my first visit and I made an urgent request outside of regular hours, they spent over an hour with me.

The doctor is incredibly knowledgeable, listened attentively, and explained everything calmly, which put me at ease.

They are truly a wonderful doctor who cares not only for pets but also for their owners.

The clinic is far from my home, so I can't visit often, but I will definitely rely on this doctor in times of need.

I would like to speak with them again.

I visited for my cat's health checkup.
First, the waiting rooms were separated for dogs and cats, and the cat room was equipped with Feliway, so I felt at ease while waiting. I was also happy to receive a sample of cat food.

They didn't seem to delve deeply into my concerns or investigate things thoroughly, so I'm not sure if it was particularly attentive. However, both the veterinarian and the nurses were very pleasant.

I would like to use their services again for health checkups and vaccinations, while also consulting with another veterinarian.

The veterinarian seemed to be handling everything alone and looked very busy, which made me feel sorry for them, so I deducted one star.

I visited this clinic because my cat was diagnosed with cancer and I wanted to discuss treatment options. The doctor was very kind and attentive, and I felt he was a very good doctor. Ultimately, it turned out that advanced medical treatment was needed, so he recommended another hospital. I would recommend this hospital as a regular veterinary clinic.

The other day, I had my 14-year-old female Chihuahua undergo surgery for endometrial hyperplasia.
As she is quite elderly, I was very worried about whether she would be able to tolerate the anesthesia and surgery, but the doctor carefully explained the risks and details of the surgery until I was satisfied, and I was able to trust him and leave the care to him.
Thanks to you, the surgery was a success, and she made a smooth postoperative recovery and is now in good health.
I am truly grateful for the warm support of the doctor and staff. I would recommend this veterinary hospital to anyone with an elderly pet.

My beloved cat's ear bleeding wasn't getting better at our regular vet, and after much deliberation about where to seek a second opinion, I decided to go to this hospital.

I was surprised at how much difference even something as simple as ear cleaning can make between hospitals.

The doctor was very calm and kind, easy to talk to, and examined my cat thoroughly, truly showing compassion to both my cat and me, the owner.

Ultimately, it was discovered that my cat had cancer and underwent surgery, but the referral to a university hospital was smooth.

They also introduced me to an oxygen chamber rental service when needed.

I appreciated that the waiting rooms were separated for dogs and cats.

The nurses were always warm and friendly, and I was deeply touched when they kindly said "I hope it works" when handing me the medication at the time of payment.

I am grateful for their excellent care throughout the entire process. Thank you very much.

I would highly recommend this hospital to any pet owners who are unsure which animal hospital to choose.

Dear Mr./Ms. Inoue,
Thank you for your feedback. We will continue to do our best for our patients!

The head doctor always examines me very carefully. When I had a full body check-up the other day, he called me beforehand because he had concerns about the blood test results.

This is a very reliable clinic.

My beloved dog had a terrible experience recently.

She was given a large amount of medication to treat an ear infection, and she became unsteady on her feet.

It's truly heartbreaking.

Recently, my dog ​​suffered a torn ligament, and my regular vet said they couldn't perform the surgery. I found this hospital and consulted with them, and they said they could do it, so I asked them to perform the surgery. They explained everything carefully on the phone and during the actual consultation, and were very kind. My dog ​​is nervous and shy around strangers, so I was worried during his hospital stay, but the doctor and nurses took such good care of him that he was able to be discharged earlier than expected. I'm so glad I had the surgery done here. Thank you very much. Based on my experience meeting and being treated by the doctor, I think he is a very caring and trustworthy doctor. I would like to continue using their services in the future.

I am a patient whose cat is being cared for here. The head veterinarian is a highly skilled, compassionate, and caring veterinarian with experience working at advanced veterinary medical institutions. During my cat's hospitalization for surgery, the doctor called me many times, even on days the clinic was closed, to report on her condition. Thanks to the doctor's careful treatment, my cat was saved. They also provide care in cooperation with advanced veterinary medical institutions when necessary.

The accident reported in the news was a very unfortunate incident. However, it is clear that the doctor is deeply hurt and remorseful, as evidenced by his tearful explanation to us, who were not directly involved, over the phone.

Comments that force the clinic to close because of this unforgivable accident cause great harm to the local animals and their owners who are being helped by the doctor's treatment. Please refrain from such comments for the sake of us who are being helped.

About two months ago, when I called to inquire about medication costs, they said they could lower the price if I was getting a cheaper prescription at another hospital, or if the monthly medication cost exceeded 10,000 yen, they could offer a discount. However, when I called today, their policy had changed. They said they couldn't answer that question over the phone and that I needed to come in for a consultation.

They also said they were too busy to answer over the phone right now.

My reason for calling was simply to find out if they could accommodate my request; I would go if they could, but I didn't want to go if they couldn't. It was just to confirm the medication cost, and they answered my question over the phone last time, so I was surprised by this significant deterioration. It's like they're telling me to pay an initial consultation fee just to ask about medication costs. Other hospitals will tell me over the phone.

The phone manner was so bad it felt like they were telling me not to come, so of course I won't be going. It makes me wonder if they used to want to attract customers, but now that it's their busy season, they don't want customers who won't bring in much money. At least, that's how I felt.

Finally, when I said, "It sounds like you're telling me not to come, sorry," they replied, "Yes, you're right," which surprised me even more. I guess this is what you get from a hospital that causes accidents. Are they even reflecting on their actions? The response was so terrible that I wrote a review for the first time. Maybe they're being arrogant because they're busy even after causing an accident... They shouldn't be asking for discounts or anything they can't do, and it was a waste of my time and a very unpleasant experience. I can't trust them, and I won't be taking my child there again.

When I got home last night, my cat was acting strangely and I was in a panic.
I was half-resigned to the fact that there wouldn't be a vet open at that time of night, but I found this one 😢
Although it was past closing time, they opened immediately when I called, which was a huge relief 😞
In the end, I'm embarrassed to say that my cat was eating her food happily, but I was so happy that they handled everything without showing any displeasure.
They were so kind and thorough with my cat, and answered all my questions and concerns, making me feel that they are a very trustworthy doctor ☺️
I also asked for some medication, and they readily accommodated my request, for which I am very grateful 😽
I usually go to a different vet nearby, but from now on I will make this my regular vet!

Thank you so much 👏🏻
